role: development integration pilot, not independent confirmation or a historical reproduction
candidate_support: frozen ten proposals plus all source profiles interpolated to target dimension; labels do not select additional profiles
coordinate_map: first ten columns of existing public ordered cosine-quadratic 65-column map
likelihood: paid constraint raw Normal likelihood with latent eta; no target sample variance label
source_fit: existing orthogonal group/spectral likelihood, Gaussian approximation for source log variance
solver_revision_reason: initial 120-iteration pilot hit the cap in four source heads; preserve that pilot and complete the same numerical objective without changing tasks, controls, likelihood or tolerances
objective_noise: pooled observed source replicate variance; fixed for target single-episode f updates
kg: two-head Gaussian-moment fantasies observing only f,g; eta changes indirectly through covariance
utility: clipped(1-f/public scalarized reference,0,1) times primary Gaussian tolerance certificate power
utility_scope: acquisition proxy; separate primary recommendation and guarded deployed outcomes are reported
terminal_support: keep legacy empirical primary as guarded incumbent, then its safe support; fill duplicates from observed initial policies
target_truth: only post-decision scoring, after all search and terminal shortlists are frozen
execution: local serial, one BLAS thread, no scheduler jobs
interpretation: tests connection and recommendation reversals; one seed per fixed family cannot establish stable source-prior superiority
